description: Upload videos, images or an HTML playable to AppLovin from Hermoso render or Library urls or public files (mp4, mov, jpg, png, gif, html; up to 40). Returns AppLovin asset ids once processed; pass uploadId to check a pending upload again. New assets go through AppLovin review. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

urls.description: files to upload; a local file goes through upload_file first

name: upload_applovin_ads_assets
title: Upload assets to AppLovin
